name: Mitten Extracts Infused Preroll | Watermelon Zkittlez
description:
1.25g Infused Preroll

Combining the sweetness of watermelon with the tropical essence of Zkittlez, this indica strain delivers a refreshing, balanced high. It induces a euphoric and calming mental state, perfect for relaxation and unwinding.
